messages:
alice_g: FYI — Tridentia procurement emailed this morning: 'We require a signed blanket PO and completed vendor registration (W-9) before any invoices are issued. We cannot accept invoices without a PO number.' Attaching their note. @ben_billing can you advise on next steps?

ben_billing: Do we have a W-9 on file for TRD-0192? If not, that's why finance is blocking invoice creation. Can you paste the account ID and the requested amount?

alice_g: Account: TRD-0192. Requested invoice for Q1 usage ~ $12,000. Customer explicitly asked that we do not issue an invoice until PO is available. They asked for an ETA for when we could bill once PO is in place.

maya_csm: I spoke with their AM — procurement is strict, they won't accept invoices without an internal PO. I already sent our vendor W-9 last week but their vendor onboarding shows 'pending verification'. They also said PO number will come after vendor setup completes.

james_procurement: From our side, policy is either a signed PO or a corporate card on file. If customer insists on PO-only, we can provide a pro-forma document for their internal purchase request, but we cannot recognize revenue or post an official invoice until procurement returns a valid PO.

raj_legal: :thinking: Pro-forma is fine to share for customer planning. Important: mark it clearly 'PROFORMA — NOT FOR PAYMENT' if we want to avoid revenue recognition pressure. Finance will still keep the account on billing hold until required docs arrive.

finance-bot: Billing hold created: HOLD-3492. Reason: missing vendor tax document (W-9) and no PO on file. Automated rule applied at 2026-04-12T14:03:22Z.

ben_billing: Practical next steps: 1) Maya — confirm whether Tridentia received the W-9 we sent and get their vendor onboarding ETA. 2) If they want something immediately, we can issue a pro-forma PDF (no ledger entry). 3) If they provide a signed PO, submit to billing and we'll convert pro-forma to official invoice.

maya_csm: I'll follow up with procurement and push for expedited onboarding. Customer estimates ~72h to finish internal approvals. I'll ask whether they'll accept the pro-forma in the meantime so their procurement team can reference it when creating the PO.

alice_g: Added a log to INC-2401 with the customer's email and the HOLD-3492 reference. Attaching the pro-forma template draft here for review: ```
Invoice: PRO-FORMA-TRD-0192
Amount: $12,000.00
Customer: Tridentia Labs
Notes: PROFORMA - NOT FOR PAYMENT - Subject to receipt of signed PO and completed vendor registration.
```

ben_billing: Looks good. Raj — any objections to sending the above pro-forma to the customer once Maya gets confirmation?

raj_legal: No objections. Make sure the wording 'not for payment' appears on the first page and that the pro-forma is not posted to any accounting system.

alice_g: Will do. Closing loop for now — will update thread when procurement confirms PO or vendor docs. INC-2401 updated; assigned to billing.
